blocks.text: Metrotown homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Metrotown, October 2026. Detached houses: 15 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 345 listed at month end and 35 sold in October, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 17 sold over 5 months against an average of 15.6 listed, about 4.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 226 sold over 5 months against an average of 351.0 listed, about 7.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 57 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Metrotown?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed with 1 sold in the month and 345 condos and townhomes listed with 35 sold in the month in Metrotown. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Metrotown a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 7%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 10%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Metrotown?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Metrotown?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
